title: LiveManifest
description: live/manifest.json: the chunks of the last 60 minutes and the state of each source.

chunk_seconds.description: Length of the ingest window covered by one chunk, seconds.

window_seconds.description: How far back the manifest lists chunks, seconds.

sources.description: One entry per source, in Source order.

ChunkRef.description: One immutable chunk: the flashes ingested during [start, start + chunk_seconds).

start.description: Start of the ingest window, aligned on chunk_seconds.

path.description: Path relative to the manifest: chunks/<start in ISO 8601 basic format>.bin.gz.

flash_count.description: Number of flashes in the chunk.

size_bytes.description: Size of the chunk file as stored (gzip), bytes.

event_min.description: Earliest event_time in the chunk; null when empty.

event_max.description: Latest event_time in the chunk; null when empty.

last_event_time.description: Latest event_time received from this source; null if never seen.

last_ingest_time.description: When the latest product file of this source was ingested; null if never seen.
